keyEvents.text: Sergio Hernández (Atlas) is shown the yellow card.
Delay in match because of an injury Camilo Vargas (Atlas).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Benjamín Galdames (Atlético San Luis) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Atlas. Milton Valenzuela replaces José Martín.
Substitution, Atlas. Aldo Rocha replaces Paulo Ramírez.
Substitution, Atlas. Ryan Mmaee replaces Sergio Hernández.
Goal! Atlético San Luis 0, Atlas 1. Florián Monzón (Atlas) right footed shot from outside the box to the top left corner. Assisted by Milton Valenzuela.
Substitution, Atlético San Luis. Román Torres replaces Benjamín Galdames.
Milton Valenzuela (Atlas) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Atlético San Luis. Leonardo Flores replaces Anderson Duarte.
Substitution, Atlas. Víctor Ríos replaces Édgar Zaldívar.
Substitution, Atlético San Luis. Luis Nájera replaces Felipe Mora.
Substitution, Atlético San Luis. Lucas Esteves replaces Aldo Cruz.
Víctor Ríos (Atlas) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Atlas. Arturo González replaces Luís Esteves.
Florián Monzón (Atlas) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
